title: kdash publisher self-test
description: Payload of kdash:selftest:{host} — latest-value, expiring (TTL 300 s). Written by a publisher wrapper to prove its whole path end to end from one host: khlenv endpoint discovery, REDISCLI_AUTH, key grammar, and a schema-valid payload. Nothing renders it; key absence simply means nobody has run the self-test from that host lately. Key is exactly 3 segments.

host.description: Echo of the key's host segment, display only; the key is authoritative

version.description: Version of the wrapper that wrote it
